tags.wheelchair:description: The height of this platform differs: At the front side it has the "normal" height allowing a wheelchair to enter the tram without a step. In the middle there is a slope, at the rear side is is low.
tags.wheelchair:description:1: The trams that usually stop here (the short types) completely fit on the heightened platform,
tags.wheelchair:description:2: but in case of long trams stopping here (happening e.g. in case of diversions), the rear part of the tram has to stop at the lower part of the platform (the front part still stops at the heightened part).
